description: US stock trading halts right now and earlier today (Nasdaq, NYSE, NYSE American and other US markets), from Nasdaq's halt feed refreshed every minute. For each: symbol, market, the reason in plain English (news pending, volatility pause, additional information requested, regulatory concern...), halt time, and when quoting and trading resume, with a status (halted, resuming_soon, resumed). Filter by one or more tickers, or omit for all.

symbols.description: Optional: one or more tickers separated by commas, e.g. "FFAI, AAPL". Omit for all current halts.
